title: A 50-Vertex Cubic Counterexample to the Domination-versus-Edge-Domination Conjecture
summary: Baste, Furst, Henning, Mohr, and Rautenbach conjectured that every finite regular graph of positive degree satisfies \(γ(G) \leq γ_e(G)\), where \(γ\) is the domination number and \(γ_e\) is the edge domination number, equivalently the minimum cardinality of a maximal matching. We show that the conjecture is false already for cubic graphs. The counterexample is a previously public 50-vertex cubic graph that had been used to refute the stronger independent-domination inequality \(i(G) \leq γ_e(G)\).
